hypotheses.explanation: PaymentService logs a charge failure and its Charge server span returns ERROR; the error propagates to PlaceOrder and checkout.
The checkout client span lasts about 74 ms while the PaymentService server span lasts about 3 ms, indicating substantial time outside server processing.
The frontend product-page span errors despite a successful, brief ProductCatalogService call, pointing to a possible frontend-side failure.
